sheets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: NEW production dance-character sprite atlas for the existing illustrated fighting game Arena Criolla.
Input image is a CANONICAL IDENTITY AND EXACT ART STYLE reference contact sheet, 8 distinct named characters in 8 ordered cells. Preserve each one's exact face, head proportions, age, hairstyle, facial hair, skin, clothing, colors, fabrics, hats, ears and tails. Realistic figures stay realistic; comic/folkloric figures keep their existing exaggeration. Match the crisp hand-inked contours, finely painted cel shading and existing adult proportions precisely. No new costume, no chibi, no photographic or 3D rendering.
Create ONE transparent PNG atlas, FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, exactly 8 complete separate figures in the SAME order as the reference. One full-body figure per cell, with at least 40 pixels transparent margin around head, hands, feet, tails and hats; consistent body scale, feet aligned per row. All face SCREEN RIGHT in three-quarter view; show recognizable face and both hands. True alpha background; no text, labels, numbers, watermark, furniture, floor or ground shadows.
ACTION FOR ALL 8: a visibly relaxed Latin pop dance MID-STEP, coordinated to a Perro Mujeriego-inspired rhythm. Weight rests on one softly bent leg while the other toe slides outward with heel raised. Hips shift to one side, shoulders counter-turn lightly. One forearm opens outward near waist, the other elbow bends with a RELAXED OPEN PALM near shoulder height, BELOW THE HEAD. Hands visibly open and loose; no fists, no boxing guard, no punch, kick attack, running or combat pose. Natural anatomy, no extra limbs. Gowns fold/swing to show a dancing weight shift with feet clear; animals perform the step in their own body proportions.
Do not include any hand-held phone, weapon, instrument, microphone, baton, staff or other loose object: hands are free for dancing. Preserve worn bags, belts, jewelry, hats and clothing. Each entire figure forms ONE connected silhouette, including tail or scarf. No detached marks.
Ordered identities:
1. Vicente Zavarce
2. Pedro Vallenilla
3. Javier Hala Madrid
4. Capriles Radonski
5. Renny Ottolina
6. Juan Vicente Gómez
7. Simón Díaz
8. Er Conde del Guácharo
